wiki.title: Beverly Gossage
wiki.extract: Beverly Gossage (born May 22, 1950) is an American politician, Medicare/Medicaid insurance broker, and former educator currently serving as a member of the Kansas Senate representing the 9th district in Johnson County, Kansas. A Republican, she was elected in 2020 to succeed retiring senator Julia Lynn. Previously, she had unsuccessfully sought the Republican nomination for Kansas Insurance Commissioner in 2014.
